name: zcode-whale-widget
description: ZCode 版 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件：常驻网页挂件显示余额与今日已用，支持峰谷定价、每轮对话消耗统计、随机台词、音效与拖拽吸附。移植自 MeteorNOX 的 DSH 版 dsh-whale-widget。

description_i18n.en: DeepSeek balance whale widget for ZCode: a persistent browser widget showing balance and today's usage, with peak/off-peak pricing, per-turn cost, quotes, sound effects, and drag-to-snap. Ported from MeteorNOX's DSH plugin dsh-whale-widget.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 版 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件：常驻网页挂件显示余额与今日已用，支持峰谷定价、每轮对话消耗统计、随机台词、音效与拖拽吸附。移植自 MeteorNOX 的 DSH 版 dsh-whale-widget。
